description: Minecraft Fabric mod for JavaScript based macros.

releases.notes:
Fixes the built-in script editor treating left clicks as right clicks on Minecraft 26.3.

The editor now uses Minecraft's right-button constant for both cursor selection and the context menu. Left clicks place the cursor or change the selection; right clicks open the menu and preserve an existing selection when clicked inside it.

Install one main JAR for your Minecraft version:

| Minecraft | JAR |
| --- | --- |
| 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 | `jsmacros-26.1-2.2.1-fabric.jar` |
| 26.2 | `jsmacros-26.2-2.2.1-fabric.jar` |
| 26.3 | `jsmacros-26.3-2.2.1-fabric.jar` |

The 26.1 and 26.2 editor implementations are unchanged. Ruby remains a separate companion mod.

Seven behavioral regression tests cover mouse buttons, selection, overlays, and widget dispatch. All 14 Python tests and the three-profile CI matrix pass. In-game mouse interaction has not been manually tested.

Fixed in #10. [Full changelog](https://github.com/grepsedawk/JSMacros/compare/v2.2.0...v2.2.1).

## Minecraft 26.1 through 26.3

Install one main JAR for your Minecraft version:

| Minecraft | JAR |
| --- | --- |
| 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 | `jsmacros-26.1-2.2.0-fabric.jar` |
| 26.2 | `jsmacros-26.2-2.2.0-fabric.jar` |
| 26.3 | `jsmacros-26.3-2.2.0-fabric.jar` |

This release updates input, inventory, world helpers, and rendering for Minecraft 26.3 while keeping the earlier stable versions supported.

Drawing fixes include Draw3D surfaces over clouds, readable back faces, item/count overlays, formatted text depth, image uploads, HUD ordering, and box color/opacity builders. The in-game rendering fixture covers 2D and 3D feature families, with cloud, wall-occlusion, layering, and lifecycle comparisons.

### Compatibility notes

- On 26.3 multiplayer servers, exact brewing recipe checks and potion previews throw `UnsupportedOperationException` when synced data cannot answer the request. Single-player uses the integrated server's recipes.
- `FurnaceInventory.getFuelValues()` is unavailable on 26.3 because durations depend on server-context components. Fuel eligibility and synced furnace timings remain available.
- Use distinct z-index values for layered, depth-tested Draw3D elements. Exactly coplanar elements can still z-fight at some camera angles.

Ruby support is provided by the separate JsMacros Ruby companion mod.

First build for Minecraft 26.2.

26.2 moved screen management off `Minecraft` onto `Gui`, split the HUD into its own class, and replaced `MultiBufferSource` with the submit-node pipeline, so this port touches 68 files and retargets a handful of mixins. Every injection descriptor was verified against the 26.2 jar before release, and the whole scripting surface (chat, keybinds, inventory, Draw2D, Draw3D, screen events, JS and external language extensions) got an in-game smoke test.

One jar can't span 26.1 and 26.2 anymore (no intermediary mappings since 26.1), so 26.1 stays on the 2.0.x line via the `26.1` branch.

Changes worth knowing about:

 - Item cooldown APIs key by cooldown-group id now (matches vanilla's new model); for normal items this is the item id, same as before
 - `isTouchscreenEnabled()` returns false and `enableTouchscreen()` no-ops; vanilla removed the option
 - Release tags now carry the Minecraft version: `v2.1.0+26.2`

A small patch on top of 2.0.1.

**Changes**
- Fixed a crash when reading an item's NBT. `getNBT()` on items carrying registry references — enchantments, for example — threw "Element ... is not valid in current registry set". Checking the enchantments on a Silk Touch pickaxe now works again.
- Opening the config from Mod Menu now starts a fresh macro screen.

Requires Minecraft 26.1.2 on Fabric.

A small patch on top of 2.0.0.

**Changes**
- Fixed Draw2D text rendering. Text now draws at its given x/y instead of always landing in the top-left corner.
- Ruby moved out to its own mod, [jsmacros-ruby](https://github.com/grepsedawk/jsmacros-ruby), and is no longer bundled here. Install it alongside JsMacros Reloaded if you write Ruby macros.

Requires Minecraft 26.1.2 on Fabric.
